text: 1 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) INSPIRE Fellowship Component (IF) Q.1. What is INSPIRE Fellowship? INSPIRE Fellowship is one of the components of the INSPIRE scheme implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India , to strengthen the Science and Technology base of the country. This Component focuses on attracting students to pursue a doctoral degree in basic and applied sciences , including engineering, medicine, agriculture, veterinary, pharmacy etc., after either a master’s (minimum 2 Years/ 4 semesters or more)/ Bachelor’s (minimum 4 Years/ 8 semesters or more) degree in science/engineering. Q.2. Who is eligible to apply for the INSPIRE Fellowship scheme? The eligibility criteria for the INSPIRE Fellowship is as follows: 1st Rank Holders in any recognized University and Academic Institutions (Excluding Autonomous Colleges) in India in Post-Graduate (PG) level examination in Basic/Applied Sciences, including Engineering, Pharmacy, Agricultural Sciences, Medicine and Veterinary Sciences. 1st Rank should be obtained in university in a basic/applied science subject course/program having a batch size of minimum 07 students with a minimum 70% marks in aggregate or its equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed, for the entire course/ program. 1st Rank Holder shall be in a complete degree examination (not just in specialization) during the two-year tenure or more. OR INSPIRE Scholar having secured minimum 70% marks in aggregate or its equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed at M.Sc. or Integrated M.S./ M.Sc. course. OR 1st Rank Holders in any recognized University and Academic Institutions (Excluding Autonomous Colleges) in India in Bachelor’s in Medicine/ B.Sc. /B.Sc. (Hons.) /B. E /B. Tech /B.V. Sc. /B.V. Sc & A.H., i.e. bachelor’s degree in Basic/Applied Sciences, including Engineering, Pharmacy, Agricultural Sciences, Medicine and Veterinary Sciences, having a batch size of minimum 07 students with minimum 75 % marks in aggregate or its equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed. 1st Rank Holder shall be in the complete degree examination (not just in specialization) during minimum four-year tenure or more for B.Sc. / B.Sc. (Hons.) / B.E. / B. Tech / B.V. Sc. / B.V. Sc. & A.H. 2 OR INSPIRE Scholar having secured a minimum 75% marks in aggregate or its equivalent grade in a point scale, wherever grading system is followed, at B.Sc. (Hons.) (4 years) or B.Sc. with Research of minimum 4 years/ 8 Semesters or more. However, merely fulfilling the eligibility criteria for the INSPIRE Fellowship will not guarantee for the final offer of fellowship. Subject Expert Committee (SEC) will finally recommend the applications for award of INSPIRE Fellowship considering the academic merit, research proposal, supervisor’s research credentials and host institution etc. parameters on a competitive basis. Q.3. When can we apply for the INSPIRE Fellowship? Call for INSPIRE Fellowship applications is announced during the 3rd/4th quarter of each financial year. Applications are sought from the eligible students through the INSPIRE web-portal: https://www.online-inspire.gov.in. Q.4. How should I apply for the INSPIRE Fellowship? One can apply for the INSPIRE Fellowship through online mode only against the call. To apply online, please visit the link https://www.online-inspire.gov.in and follow the guidelines as given therein. Q.5. Are computer-generated/ Internet marksheets for UG/ PG acceptable? Internet or computer -generated marksheets are acceptable only if they are duly authenticated. Otherwise, you are requested to upload a clear scanned copy of the original marksheets. Q.6. Is it mandatory to upload all Semester/year-wise UG/ PG marksheets? Yes, it is mandatory to upload all semester/ year-wise marksheets, combined in a single PDF, for UG/PG. Submission of only a consolidated marksheet or a final semester/ year marksheet shall not be accepted. Q.7. Is it mandatory to produce the First Rank Certificate (FRC) in the INSPIRE Fellowship format, or we can submit what we have received from the institution? Yes. It is mandatory to produce a First Rank certificate, strictly in the prescribed INSPIRE Fellowship Format only, without any modifications/ striking/ overwriting (Format is available at https://www.online-inspire.gov.in). In place of the FRC, the Provisional Rank certificate or mark sheet will not be acceptable. Any uploaded FRC 3 that deviates from the prescribed format is liable to be rejected. Q.8. What is the selection procedure? Selection among the applicants is done in two stages , i.e. Level -I Screening for eligibility criteria and Level-II Evaluation by Subject Expert Committee (SEC). 1. Applicants who are already admitted into the Ph.D. Program in S&T subject areas prior to the submission of the application and upon recommendation at both the Levels (Level-I & Level-II) shall be awarded a Final Offer of INSPIRE Fellowship. 2. Applicants who have not been admitted into Ph.D. Program in S&T subject areas prior to submission of application and get a recommendation at Level I, shall be awarded a Provisional Offer for INSPIRE Fellowship and they will be given two slots of one month each, separated by a gap of approximately 5-6 months for uploading Ph.D. admission documents during 1-year duration. The Provisional Offer is made to the eligible applicant(s) on the basis of scrutiny of the application with respect to its completeness , including the requisite documents (Level-I). However, issue of the Provisional Offer does not guarantee the award of INSPIRE Fellowship. Final Offer is made to the eligible applicants on the basis of evaluation of the application at Level -II, considering i) Academic merit ii) Host Institution, including Research Supervisor CV and iii) detailed Research Proposal, by the Subject Expert Committee. In the Level-II Evaluation process, applicants need to secure a minimum qualifying score/cut -off and the cut-off score may vary based on the competitive framework of the selection process. Q.9. What is the difference between Provisional Offer and Final Offer of INSPIRE Fellowship? Provisional Offer: Students who are eligible for the INSPIRE Fellowship but not admitted into Ph.D. program would get a Provisional Offer and they will be given two slots of one month each , with a gap of about 5-6 months for uploading Ph.D. documents during 1-year duration. Final Offer: Students who are eligible for the INSPIRE Fellowship as well as got admitted into Ph.D. program and their applications are recommended at both the levels (Level-I and Level-II) would be given a final offer for the INSPIRE Fellowship. Q.10. What is the tenure of this Fellowship? Fellowship shall be tenable for a maximum period of five years from the INSPIRE Fellowship activation date or completion of the Ph.D. program (i.e. up to the date of successful Ph.D. viva-voce), whichever is earlier. The fellowship shall be governed by the administrative norms and guidelines of the Host University/Institute. 4 Q.11. What would be our designation after selection under INSPIRE Fellowship? The entry in the INSPIRE Fellowship would be only as a Junior Research Fellow (JRF). There is no direct entry into Senior Research Fellow (SRF). The JRF or SRF under this scheme shall be termed as 'INSPIRE Fellow'. Q.12. What is the amount of the Fellowship? The Fellowship shall be governed through the Office Memorandum of this Ministry of Number A.20020/11/97-IFD dated 6thAugust 2007; 31st March 2010; 21stOctober 2014 [No. SR/S9/Z-09/2012] and SR/S9/Z-08/2018 dated 30thJanuary 2019 and DST/PCPM/Z- 06/2022 dated 26th June 2023. However, HRA to the Fellows shall also be applicable as per GoI norms depending upon the location of the Host Institute. Q.13. What are the norms for Contingency Expenditure? Expenditure of contingency grant would be governed as per the host institution norms. The limit of contingency grant is Rs. 20,000/annum. The unspent balance/limit of contingency grant at the end of a year shall be adjusted to the next year with a maximum ceiling of Rs. 20,000. Q.14. Where will be the amount of Fellowship transferred? Fellowship limit shall be assigned through PFMS to the student’s Host institution , i.e. Working Institution’s ZBSA Bank Account in Union Bank of India , following TSA Hybrid 1A Model. The host institute shall transfer monthly fellowship to the students’ bank account following the host institute’s norms. Sanction Order of the respective Fellow shall be available in their web-portal account. INSPIRE Fellows will download a copy of the sanction order and submit the same to the Host institution for further necessary action. To receive Fellowship grant, Host institute(s) need to have a Zero - balance Subsidiary A/c [Preferable Name of A/c: *Institution Name*_Vigyan Dhara] to operate as a Sub Agency A/c at an institutional level (i.e. respective institute/organization) in Union Bank of India and get mapped and flagged the ZB SA in PFMS (Public Fi nance Management System: https://www.pfms.nic.in). Institute will operationalize the new process, i.e. TSA Hybrid 1A for the flow of funds through ZBSA at Union Bank of India for utilization of the Fellowship grant (for further details, please visit “Notice Board Section” of INSPIRE web-portal (https://www.online-inspire.gov.in). Q.15. What is PFMS? Public Financial Management System (PFMS: https://pfms.nic.in) is being 5 implemented by the Office of Controller General of Accounts, Ministry of Finance , in partnership with National Informatics Centre. PFMS has established a common transaction-based online fund management and payment system for the Schemes of the Government of India. Q.16. Is it mandatory that the Host Institute should be registered under PFMS for receiving the Fellowship Limit ? Yes. It is mandatory. Else Fellowship limit shall not be assigned. Q.17. What will be the activation date of the INSPIRE Fellowship? The activation date for availing of the INSPIRE Fellowship would be as follows: a. Applicants enrolled in Ph.D.: The INSPIRE Fellowship activation date shall be the day immediately following the closing date of the advertisement or a day after relieving from previous fellowship/ services, whichever is later. b. Applicants not enrolled in Ph.D.: The INSPIRE Fellowship activation date shall be the day immediately following the closing date of the documents uploading slot(s) or a day after relieving from the previous fellowship/ services, whichever is later. c. If the fellow resigns from the previous fellowship with effect from backdate, even then his/her fellowship effective date will be the day immediately following the closing date of the documents uploading slot/(s) or a day after relieving from previous fellowship/ services, whichever is later. Q.18. What is the procedure to transfer the Fellowship from one host institute to another host institute? An INSPIRE Fellow who once accepts the offer of Fellowship at a particular University/ Institute/ Laboratory shall not be allowed to transfer the Fellowship to another University/Institute/Laboratory across the country during the 5 years of Fellowship tenure. However, in unavoidable circumstances, the Fellow must seek prior permission from INSPIRE-DST for transfer/ change of Host Institute by submitting an application with the following documents: 1. No Objection Certificates (NoCs) from both Host Institutes and Research Supervisors (both old and new). 2. Detailed Justifications for the shift/ change of Host Institute for continuation of Fellowship. 3. Up-to-date Research Progress Report. 4. CV of the Research Supervisor at the new Host Institute. 5. Up-to-date Financial Statement from the initial Host Institute. 6 6. An undertaking from the INSPIRE Fellow that he/she will be able to complete the Ph.D. program within the initially approved fellowship duration. Undertaking shall be forwarded through the new supervisor. However, a shift / change of Host Institute without prior approval from DST-INSPIRE will lead to withdrawal of the INSPIRE Fellowship. Moreover, such a shift / change of Host Institute may be allowed only once in 5 years tenure of Fellowship and within one year of the effective date of Fellowship at the respective Host Institute. If an INSPIRE fellow leaves without permission, the due stipend shall not be paid to him/her by the Institution without the permission of DST. Q.19. I am already receiving another fellowship. What should I do to switch over to the INSPIRE Fellowship? When you receive the Final offer under the INSPIRE Fellowship, please resign from the previous fellowship for switching over to the INSPIRE Fellowship and put these details in Joining -cum-Acceptance letter (Format provided at https://www.online- inspire.gov.in). Please do not resign unless you receive the Final offer of the INSPIRE Fellowship. Q.20. I have received an invitation to do a short research internship program that is relevant to my Ph.D. degree . Can I avail this short -term internship during my INSPIRE Fellowship tenure? An INSPIRE Fellow shall be allowed to avail a short-term Research Internship at any national or international Laboratory/ University/ Institute up to a maximum period of 18 months, either in one or multiple slots, during 5-year tenure of the Fellowship. This research internship would be arranged by the individual Fellow or the host institution. The Fellow shall obtain prior permission from DST-INSPIRE on the recommendation of Ph.D. Research Supervisor , as well as confirmation from the Research Internship provider. In case the Fellow receives full financial support for the internship from the overseas institution(s), the INSPIRE Fellowship for the period of Overseas stay shall not be remitted. After availing the Research Internship, the Fellow must submit his/her Internship Report as well as their Joining Report to the Host Institution, with intimation to DST. Q.21. I have to attend an International Conference. Would the INSPIRE Fellowship pay for the travel and journey fare charges? No. Q.22. What should be done for getting next instalment of my Fellowship? 7 INSPIRE Fellow need to upload the Utilization Certificate (UC), Statement of Expenditure (SE), Claim Bill (if any) and Annual Progress Report in the prescribed format(s) (available at https://www.online-inspire.gov.in) in the INSPIRE web-portal at the end of every financial year for the assignment of the next instalment limit. Q.23. What are the things to be remembered while preparing the correct and acceptable SE, UC and claim bill? Second installment onward assignment to an ongoing Fellow will be considered if the unspent balance/limit from the previously assigned Fellowship limit, including HRA shall be less than Rs. 40,000/-. In case , multiple SE and UC have to be uploaded, please make a single file of multiple SE(s) and another file of multiple UC(s) and upload at the appropriate place. SE and UC without the Seal of Competent Authority shall not be accepted. Uploaded SE and UC should be clearly visible. Q.24. How much time will be taken after uploading the SE, UC and claim bill for processing? From the date of upload of the requisite documents, generally, the fellowship limit shall be assigned within 2 months. Q.25. When will I be eligible for the upgradation of my Fellowship from JRF to SRF? The up-gradation of Fellowship from Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) to Senior Research Fellowship (SRF) would normally be considered after completion of two (2) years of INSPIRE Fellowship. However, it can be considered after completion of one year as JRF if the INSPIRE Fellow has an acceptance of at least one research paper (as a 1st Author) in SCI indexed journal from the Ph.D. work carried out at the respective Host Institute. Q.26. What is the procedure for upgradation from JRF to SRF? For the up-gradation of Fellowship, a three (3)- member Assessment Committee shall be constituted by the Vice-Chancellor/Director/Head of the Host Institute to assess the progress of the concerned INSPIRE Fellow. The Assessment Committee shall include the Research Supervisor of the concerned INSPIRE Fellow and one Faculty from the Host Institution as a Members and a DST -nominated expert who will act as the Chairperson. The host institute need not approach DST for the name of the DST-nominated expert who will be the chairperson of the Assessment Committee. The Host institute may choose one Fellow of any of the following four National Academies as the DST -nominated Expert and the Chairperson of the Assessment Committee, subject to: 8 i. his/her being in the concerned area of research, ii. his/her being from an institution other than the Host Institution; iii. his/her being not related to the INSPIRE Fellow and/or his/her Research Supervisor; and iv. Research Supervisor of the INSPIRE Fellow not having been his/her research student: Indian National Science Academy (INSA), New Delhi Indian Academy of Sciences (IAS), Bengaluru National Academy of Sciences, India (NASI), Prayagraj, and Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE), New Delhi. INSPIRE Fellow has to upload the Assessment Report on the INSPIRE Web- portal as detailed in the JRF to SRF up-gradation guidelines. Q.27. I got a job. Please tell me what is the procedure to discontinue my INSPIRE Fellowship? Upon getting a job, INSPIRE Fellow shall upload the following documents in his/ her INSPIRE web-Portal account: a. Ph.D. Discontinuation Report (Status Report) along with the resignation letter forwarded by the Supervisor, b. Statement of Expenditure (SE), Utili zation certificate (UC) and claim form (if any) for the complete fellowship duration, c. Soft copy of the status report, published research papers and patent details, if any, shall be submitted in a USB storage device to the INSPIRE-DST by speed post. Q.28. I have completed my Ph.D. under the INSPIRE Fellowship. What are the completion formalities? After completion of Ph.D./ fellowship tenure to settle the fellowship grant, the INSPIRE Fellow shall upload the following documents in his/her INSPIRE Web-Portal account: i) A copy of the Ph.D. degree certificate, Ph.D. completion report, Statement of Expenditure (SE), Utilization Certificate (UC) and Claim form (if any) of the complete fellowship duration. ii) Soft copy of the Ph.D. thesis, published research papers and patent details, if any, shall be submitted in a USB storage device to the INSPIRE-DST by speed post. INSPIRE Fellows must settle their claims within one year of leaving the Fellowship. No claim will be admitted by DST after one year of leaving the Fellowship. 9 Q.29. I am an INSPIRE Fellow. I got a government job. Can I join my job and hold my INSPIRE fellowship for some period? I want to join the INSPIRE Fellowship again after completing my probation period of job, with permission from the employer? If you join any job (full-time or part-time), there is no provision for holding INSPIRE Fellowship and rejoining after some time. Your Fellowship will be discontinued from the date of joining the job. Q.30. What are the other things that I need to remember during my tenure under the INSPIRE Fellowship? 1. All communication related to the INSPIRE Fellowship should be through the INSPIRE web-portal; therefore, keep updating yourself by visiting your INSPIRE web-portal account. 2. Keep checking the website and registered email for any updates. 3. Acknowledge the financial support of DST -INSPIRE in your research credentials (Publications, patents, etc.) during the Fellowship tenure. Q.31. Do I need to wait for my bank details to be approved before submitting my joining-Cum- acceptance documents? Already, DST-approved bank details of respective institutions are available on the INSPIRE Web-portal. If you select the required bank details from the list, then you do not need to wait for its approval. You can directly upload your joining - cum-acceptance report. Q.32. I was awarded the final offer of the INSPIRE Fellowship. I had to upload bank details, then Joining- cum-Acceptance (JCA) within one month of Fellowship Final offer. What should I do if I cannot do it within the validity? If selected INSPIRE Fellow fails to upload JCA within one month from the date of issue of the final offer letter, the offer shall automatically stand withdrawn. Q.33. What should I do if m y provisional offer validity is now over , as I could not upload my Ph.D. admission documents in the online portal? This is an automated process. If a student fails to upload his/ her Ph.D. admission documents within the validity duration, the portal will automatically closed and then he/ she will not be able to upload Ph.D. admission documents for its consideration for the Final Offer. In that case, his/ her provisional offer will automatically stand 10 withdrawn. Q.34. I had filled my Bank details after receiving the final offer and was waiting for its approval. How would I know that my documents are approved? Once you submit the host institute’s bank details, it takes one week for approval. You are requested to regularly check your INSPIRE web-portal account for updates. Q.35 . Whether Re-submission of any rejected application is possible or not. If so, details. Yes. Re-submission is possible. Applicants whose INSPIRE Fellowship applications are not recommended for the INSPIRE Fellowship will have to apply for Re - submission by filling the consent form on the INSPIRE web-portal within 30 days from the date of non -recommendation letter. Thereafter, Applicants must upload the updated/ modified research proposal against the reverted research proposal in their INSPIRE web-portal account once during the immediate next application slot. The application portal will remain active for 30 days in the next i mmediate slot. Re- submission requests shall be submitted through the online INSPIRE web -portal https://online-inspire.gov.in/Account/reevaluation. ****
